summary.intent: Land PR 3 of ADR 0005 (span-based snippet and dedup in monokl) via a delegated subagent, and begin the follow-up Variant V name-boost PR.
summary.outcome: Subagent opened PR #107 (+822/-371), stacked on #105, with lint, tests, rg-compare, changesets and bench all passing; CI was still pending and the diff had not been reviewed. Variant V name-boost work was started in parallel from main.

repo: ADR 0005 work is delivered as stacked PRs; #107 is based on feat/span-hit-ownership (#105) and must merge after #105. Intended merge order is #106, #105, #107, with release PR #97 also waiting.
Analyzer spans nest or are disjoint, so the dedup rule 'half of the smaller block in bytes' reduces to containment or equality.
CodeBlock::signature_span (bytes of a declaration's head) was added because span-based dedup needed it.
name_match_boost already reads CodeBlock::name (moved in §39), so the name-boost work does not depend on the span PRs and can branch from main.
Verification suite: just lint, just test, just rg-compare, just changesets, just bench. rg-compare baselines: 58/59, 17/18, 15/16, Rust 22/24, held-out 32/33 and 22/22, held-out Rust 34/36.
Bench allowance is 5%; stress/many moved 459.9 to 470.3 ms (+2.3%) using the minimum p50 of alternating old/new runs.
Changesets for user-visible output changes use a minor bump with 'Breaking:' notes.
workflow: Subagent results are reported as the agent's claims; the diff was not independently read, so review before merging.
Independent follow-up work can be parallelized by branching from main when it has no dependency on the stacked PRs.
Snippet output changes (184 of 421 queries) affect what downstream agents read, so a before/after on a real query is worth checking before merging.

friction: PR #107 is UNSTABLE because CI checks are still pending.
Stacked PR ordering means #107 cannot merge until #105 does.
open_items: User should review a before/after snippet on a real query before merging #107.
Wait for CI on #107 and merge in order: #106, #105, #107.
Variant V name-boost PR in progress; it should list every pinned-harness query whose top 5 changes and explain each.
